releaseNotes: Fixes the v78 UI result where two grids matched and the stale Wire remained visible despite successful host removal. v79 excludes personal-inventory grids using Unreal item-object ownership, targets the single cargo grid, calls the normal update event, and removes only a stale withdrawn-item widget if it no longer exists in BP_Cargo.StorageItems. Update both PCs after closing Breathedge and repeat the one-Wire open-locker withdrawal test.
